rationale: Shareholder-association archive of bank AGM materials; useful actor colour but weak for A4 payment/ATM/POS statistics.
Single Vecer article on OTP results — evidence only; trace back to the primary bank release.
Filing aggregator, convenient discovery layer but redundant to issuer/BSI primaries and URL unverified.
Authoritative ZBS member directory of banks, savings banks and leasing firms — mine once for the actor map.
Association-curated banking-sector indicator series — a stable market-structure baseline directly on A4 scope.
ZBS press-release hub: continuously produces sector positions on cash access, instant payments and card fraud.
25-year annual-report series giving the longitudinal payments/cash narrative for the SI banking sector.
Bancni vestnik archive is the deepest SI analytic layer on payments but sits behind a paid subscription.
National payment-standards repository (UPN QR, ISO 20022, purpose codes) — the technical rails and their integrators.
Static SEPA information page on zbs-giz.si; covered by monitoring the ZBS parent and payments section.
Self-regulation guidelines section of ZBS; low update cadence, captured via the parent domain crawl.
SL-EN payments glossary — harvest once to build the local-language query vocabulary, then archive.
Merchant-side chamber on the National Payments Council — acceptance-cost and interchange positions for SI retail.
GZS trade branch chamber representing SME merchants exposed to POS acceptance and cash-handling costs.
Index of ~30 GZS branch chambers — snowball once for payment-relevant nodes (PTZ, ZIT), not monitored.
ICT branch association exposing the POS/fiscalisation vendor layer that no bank register lists (do_not_narrow applies).
Craft/micro-merchant chamber — primary voice on cash-vs-card economics and mPOS/softPOS adoption.
Only regularly refreshed cross-bank retail fee/ATM-cost comparison outside the central bank; parts need paid access.
Flik instant-payment scheme site publishes adoption figures and merchant rules; failed check is soft, re-verify liveness.
Single 24ur article on the cash-rights constitutional amendment; important context but a one-off artifact from an activist actor.
ZBS training catalogue — a weak demand signal, adequately covered under the association parent.
GZS chamber magazine; broad business commentary with thin payments-statistics yield, sibling of the GZS parent.
Bankart is the domestic card switch/processor — ecosystem core stating card, POS and ATM operating scale.
A single audited Bankart annual-report PDF: high-value evidence; monitor the reports listing page rather than this file.
Static BSI card-settlement description; one of 39 bsi.si pages, covered by monitoring the central-bank parent.
Authoritative BSI register of licensed payment-system operators — mine for the switch/scheme actor map, recheck periodically.
Central-bank statistical release series carrying the national card, ATM and POS denominators — the A4 backbone.
